topic: The single biggest mistake companies make when planning corporate events
hook: Most companies spend 80% of their budget on the venue — and wonder why nobody remembers the event.
script_he: רוב החברות מוציאות 80% מהתקציב על הוונו — ואז תוהות למה אף אחד לא זוכר את האירוע. הסוד שאנחנו למדנו אחרי 1,500 אירועים ב-130 יעדים? הרגע שאנשים זוכרים הוא לא הבמה — זה הרגע שהם הרגישו משהו. חוויה אחת בלתי צפויה, אישית, שנוגעת בבן אדם — שווה יותר מכל הפקה מושלמת. אם אתם מתכננים את האירוע הבא שלכם, תחשבו קודם כל על הרגש. את השאר — תשאירו לנו. לינק בביו.
script_en: Most companies spend 80% of their budget on the venue — and wonder why nobody remembers the event. Here's what we've learned after 1,500 events across 130+ destinations: people don't remember the stage, the lighting, or the catering. They remember how they felt. One unexpected, personal moment that actually moves people is worth more than a flawless production. So before you book the ballroom — design the feeling first. The rest? We've got you. Link in bio.
captions: 80% on the venue. 0% on the feeling. 🤔
Then build the event around it ✨
post_caption: The most expensive events are often the least memorable — and there's a reason for that. 👀 After 16 years and 1,500+ corporate events around the world, we can tell you: the secret isn't the budget. It's the moment. The one unexpected, human experience that makes your people feel something real. That's what they talk about on Monday morning. That's what brings them back next year. Stop designing logistics.
